Color roles

Light theme. Run npm run check for contrast results.

color.text.default#29292ABody and headings.
color.text.muted#454546Secondary text, help text, captions. Still AA on surface.default and surface.subtle.
color.text.inverse#FFFFFFText on dark or brand surfaces.
color.text.link#005F5CGreen 700, not 600: links also sit on surface.subtle where 600 falls below 4.5:1. Underline links in body text.
